title: CLAUDE.md rule cards come labelled
text: When you accept a rule for a repository's CLAUDE.md, Obeya collects it on an "Add to CLAUDE.md" card. That card now arrives labelled Docs and Configuration, so it stands out on the canvas at a glance. Obeya makes the card itself, so these are set labels rather than suggestions, and you can still change them like any other label.
chapters: The owner can still change them
